objective: Count how many of the specified products have at least 2 items available today at the Vienna Praterstern hardware store.

params.store: lookup store by name 'Vienna Praterstern' and city 'Vienna' from stores table
params.product_1: find product_sku and record_path from product_variants where brand='Gardena', series='Gardena Smart PowerMax 280-5FI Manual Garden Tool', model='Manual Garden Tool' and join product_variant_properties where property_key='tool type' and property_value_text='pruning saw'
params.product_2: find product_sku and record_path from product_variants where brand='Viega', series='Viega Professional Sanpress 2OG-ENN Pipe Fitting', model='Pipe Fitting' and join product_variant_properties where property_key='fitting type' and property_value_text='pipe fitting' and property_key='diameter' and property_value_text='15 mm' and property_key='connection type' and property_value_text='threaded'
params.product_3: find product_sku and record_path from product_variants where brand='Sika', series='Sika Professional Sika 28T-UV8 Sealant', model='Sealant' and join product_variant_properties where property_key='sealant type' and property_value_text='hybrid sealant' and property_key='color family' and property_value_text='Gray' and property_key='volume' and property_value_text='280 ml'
params.product_4: find product_sku and record_path from product_variants where brand='Portwest', series='Portwest PW3 DX 3TU-ST2 Work Gloves', model='Work Gloves' and join product_variant_properties where property_key='size' and property_value_text='S'
params.product_5: find product_sku and record_path from product_variants where brand='Ryobi', series='Ryobi Precision RLM 2KQ-R4C Cordless Saw and Sander', model='Cordless Saw and Sander' and join product_variant_properties where property_key='tool type' and property_value_text='planer'
params.product_6: find product_sku and record_path from product_variants where brand='Portwest', series='Portwest PW3 DX 3TU-ST2 Work Gloves', model='Work Gloves' and join product_variant_properties where property_key='size' and property_value_text='M'

constraints.rule: must include a decision branch to handle the case where the store is not found.
